object_description: compact five-level volume with a shifting central void
design_condition: The compact volume is placed as a prominent campus building balancing its neighbouring buildings, though a more orthogonal alignment is questioned for coherence.

positive.statement: Its size and urban concept provide a judicious response to the campus composition.
The central collective space achieves high spatial quality through varied floor openings and shifting dimensions.
The functional groups are well sized and their internal relationships correctly established.
The load transfer through the central space is resolved elegantly with judiciously arranged structural walls.
The project has one of the most advantageous form coefficients and is among the most compact schemes.
The technical concepts are relatively simple, and natural atrium ventilation is considered a good solution.

negative.statement: An orthogonal position could provide better coherence with the surrounding buildings.
The collective spaces could create use problems unless noise management is perfectly resolved.
The ground floor is not generous enough for members of the public arriving from outside.
Part of the facade solution is considered somewhat timid.
The central core still requires improvement in natural lighting.
The ground-floor supporting system contains singularities that require optimization.
A concept for electric lighting integrated with natural-light management is missing.
